name: crystoline/xpsr
description: XPSR application skeleton: a PHP framework built around PSR interfaces and interchangeable components

suggest.crystoline/xpsr-cache: Application cache (PSR-16 and PSR-6) and the cache:clear command
suggest.crystoline/xpsr-http-client: Outgoing HTTP: a configured PSR-18 client and named clients
suggest.crystoline/xpsr-log-monolog: Monolog logging: stderr, file, daily, or syslog; JSON lines; request IDs
suggest.crystoline/xpsr-orm-doctrine: Doctrine ORM entities on the XPSR database connection
suggest.crystoline/xpsr-validation: Request validation: input classes with Symfony Validator rules, 422 with field errors
suggest.crystoline/xpsr-router-sunrise: Sunrise router adapter. Select it with: php xpsr setup --router=sunrise --install-dependencies
